From: Frida Alvarez <frida@codeharbor.org>

Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Redwood GitHub integration — quick demo and technical Qs

Hi Stephanie,

I signed up for a trial last night and poked around the GitHub connector. Looks promising — we run a few private repos and a handful of public OSS projects and would love to see the product in action. A few quick things up front so we can make the most of a demo:

- Do you support installing a GitHub App into private orgs (org-level app) or only repo-level tokens?
- Any special OAuth scopes required (we're sensitive about read/write)?
- We use webhooks to trigger CI; curious whether the connector supports webhook delivery or if you rely on polling.

Would love a short walkthrough (20–30m) next week. I’m on Pacific time. Suggested windows: Tue/Wed mornings PT.

I attached a quick CSV with the repo names we expect to sync. Happy to redact anything sensitive for the demo.

Thanks,
Frida Alvarez
Head of Developer Experience
CodeHarbor

Attachment: codeharbor-repos.csv (text/csv, 28KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Frida Alvarez <frida@codeharbor.org>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 18:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood GitHub integration — quick demo and technical Qs

Hi Frida — great to meet you over email, and thanks for the repo list. I can definitely walk you through how our GitHub connector works and the different installation options. Quick answers while I pull Logan (our AE/SE) into the thread for the technical deep-dive:

- Installation: we support both org-level GitHub Apps and repo-level installations. Org-level is best for the single-sign install for all repos.
- Scopes: for read-only code metadata and webhooks we request repo and admin:repo_hook if you want webhook management; no write to code unless you opt-in for actions-based automation.
- Webhooks vs polling: we can subscribe to webhooks and do event-driven sync; there’s also a lightweight polling fallback for legacy setups.

Would Weds 10:00–10:30 PT (June 9) or Thu 11:00–11:30 PT work for you? If those don’t, send a few slots and I’ll match. Also — are any of the repos in the CSV private repos in a different GitHub org than codeharbor.org? If so, mention them and we’ll make sure we show a private-repo walkthrough.

Looping in Logan (cc) to answer any deeper infra/security questions. I’ll set a calendar invite once we confirm a time.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
SDR, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
